name.description: Name attribute of the textarea. Required.

id.description: Id of the textarea. Generated with a random suffix when omitted, so the same field can render twice on one page.

label.description: Visible label of the field. Without it no label element is rendered.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for fields that have no visible label. Forwarded to the control.

value.description: Initial content of the textarea. Can also be passed as the default content of the component.

placeholder.description: Placeholder attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

description.description: Hint below the field. Linked to the textarea via aria-describedby.

autocomplete.description: Autocomplete attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

rows.description: Rows attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

minlength.description: Minlength attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

maxlength.description: Maxlength attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

disabled.description: Disabled attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

readonly.description: Readonly attribute of the textarea. Forwarded to the control.

validationRules.description: Comma separated list of client-side validation rules, rendered as data-validation.

violationPath.description: Key the server-side violations of this field are stored under.

formViolations.description: ConstraintViolationException holding the server-side violations of the request. Defaults to the `formViolations` Twig global; pass it explicitly to render a field outside a request scope.

required.description: Renders the required marker and aria-required.
